_note: Shared tool policy for the built-in web chat, Retell website chat agent, and Retell phone agent. JSON-Schema parameters work for both OpenAI-style function calling and Retell custom functions. Retell should call the HTTP endpoints listed under `http` (append ?channel=website_chat or ?channel=retell) with header `Authorization: Bearer $AGENT_TOOL_SECRET`. Only these tools are allowed; SiteLink AI features are never used.

tools.name: search_units
tools.description: Search currently available storage units and parking from KV's cached SiteLink inventory (refreshed ~every 30 minutes). Returns sizes, monthly price, count available, features, a link to hold online, and an 'as of' time. Also returns unit types that are currently full so you can offer the waitlist.

location.description: haley = 20 Haley Rd Antigonish; hwy4 = 2784 NS-4 Addington Forks (Exit 31); stellarton = 30 Heritage Ave Stellarton. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Look up answers from the canonical KV FAQ by keyword (hours, access, Noke, climate, parking, payments, refunds, student storage, maintenance, transfers, move-out, what to bring).

tools.name: capture_lead
tools.description: Send a lead to GoHighLevel. Use when the wanted unit is unavailable, for the waitlist, when the person asks to be contacted, or on human handoff. Requires a name and a phone or email. Confirm details with the person first.

tools.name: handoff_to_human
tools.description: Tell the person how to reach staff now and flag the conversation for a human. Use for refunds, exceptions, billing disputes, complaints, or when asked for a person.

summary.description: One-line summary of what the person needs.
